turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
It won't be easy. What do you have besides the software?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. This is the one I picked. Show me something with a date on it, or the zero comes off.
